comment: Mantine bake pin. scripts/fetch-mantine.mjs reads this to vendor the npm tarballs the ui.mantine.dev demos (and @mantine itself) need at runtime: the union of the components' packages arrays plus the full transitive chains of @mantine/core, @mantine/carousel and @mantine/dropzone. react/react-dom are NOT vendored: the frontend build already provides them. Types-only packages with no runtime imports (@tabler/icons, type-fest, @standard-schema/spec) are absent on purpose. Bump versions here and re-run npm run mantine to refresh the layer.
